t: A palm-sized AI camera with a round screen that watches and listens.
steps: Buy the W1-A vision edition or the XiaoZhi voice edition from Seeed Studio or a maker shop.
Install the SenseCraft app on your phone.
Plug the bottom USB-C port into a power adapter and turn the Watcher on.
Pair it with the app and join your Wi-Fi network.
Type a first task, such as "tell me when a person appears."
Walk in front of the camera and watch for the alert on your phone.
Try the Home Assistant guide in the Seeed repo for your next step.
meta: Open Board. From $49.41. A few stores.
